tools.name: agent_send_email
tools.description: Dispatches transactional or alert emails on behalf of an autonomous AI agent. Automatically compiles Markdown into responsive HTML emails (0.005 USDC via x402 on Base).

tools.name: agent_preview_email
tools.description: Read-only dry-run validation and Markdown-to-HTML compilation preview for autonomous AI agent emails (0.005 USDC via x402 on Base). Validates recipients and returns compiled HTML byte metrics without sending external emails.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: agent_preview_email · Public sink: agent_send_email, agent_preview_email · Destructive: agent_preview_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: agent_preview_email · Public sink: agent_send_email, agent_preview_email · Destructive: agent_preview_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
